title: ALMA Observations of Multiple CO and C Lines toward the Active Galactic Nucleus of NGC 7469: An X-Ray-dominated Region Caught in the Act
question: Does the [C I](1-0) to CO/13CO line ratio at ~100 pc scale distinguish the AGN (XDR) from the starburst ring in NGC 7469, and what are the gas conditions and CO/CI-to-H2 conversion factors?

data.arrays: 12m array (two configurations, Bands 3-7); ACA in Band 8; no total power

what.value: Single-dish [CI], CO(2-1), 13CO(2-1) line fluxes of galaxy sample and NGC 7469 SD ratios

evidence.quote: we again compiled line flux data of \[C I\](1–0), CO(2–1), and $^{13}$CO(2–1) from (cite: 2015A&A...578A..95I).
Values are adopted from the LAMDA database (cite: 2005AA...432..369S).

recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, uv-plane continuum subtraction, concat, clean with Briggs weighting
key_parameters: robust 0.0 (Bands 6-8); robust 0.5 with outertaper 0.2'' (Band 3); dV = 10 km/s (20 for 13CO)

recipe.goal: Make moment maps and measure line fluxes/spectra
recipe.method: Moment-0 over 4650-5200 km/s; spectra at positions A-D with 0.38'' aperture; single/double Gaussian fits; luminosities
key_parameters: Positions A-D defined from Band 7 860 um continuum peaks

recipe.goal: Compute line ratios and compare with single-dish sample
recipe.method: T_B ratios of [CI]/CO(2-1) and [CI]/13CO(2-1) at A-D; compared with Israel et al. 2015 sample
Optically thin LTE R_CI/13CO as function of Tex and NC/NCO; CO rotation diagrams for Tex
RADEX grid over Tkin, nH2, C0/CO, N_CO/dV compared with observed ratios
3DBarolo tilted-ring fits to [CI](1-0) and CO(2-1) cubes; Mdyn = r Vrot^2/G
key_parameters: 50 rings, dr = 0.05'' from r = 0.10''; Vsys fixed 4920 km/s; center fixed to AGN; initial i = 45, PA = 128

recipe.method: HST color-based M/L with MGE deprojection; Mmol = Mdyn - Mstar - MBH; alpha = Mmol/L'
assumptions: H2 dominates gas mass in CND; hydrogen nuclei fraction 71%; no dark matter

answer_key.quantity: R_CI/13CO at position A, channel 4900 km/s

evidence.quote: we find $M_{\rm dyn} = 2.3 \times 10^8~M_\odot$ after averaging \[C I\](1–0)-based and CO(2–1)-based values, which has $\sim 15\%$ uncertainty.
we derive the total gas mass at $r \leq 0\ensuremath{''}.19$ as $M_{\rm mol} = 9.5 \times 10^7~M_\odot$
$\alpha_{\rm CO}$ = 4.1 $M_\odot$ (K km s$^{-1}$ pc$^2$)$^{-1}$ and $\alpha_{\rm CI}$ = 4.4

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels used for continuum subtraction and rms
clean threshold, masking, niter and image size
Whether Band 7 compact-configuration data exclusion detail and flagging beyond pipeline
Exact aperture/spectrum extraction procedure and Gaussian-fit initial guesses
3DBarolo settings (mask, normalization, weighting) beyond ring geometry
MGE fitting details and HST stellar mass profile (deferred to Nguyen et al.)
RADEX line-width and grid details beyond parameter lists, and how models were compared with observed ratios
missing_for_reproduction: HST stellar mass profile (in prep paper)
score_reason: Data identified and many key steps given, but imaging and modeling details and HST stellar mass are incomplete.
rediscovery_reason: Data from a single Cycle 5 project, line fluxes and ratios are numeric, and the Gaussian-fit/ratio recipe is largely specified.
